title: Boom Bap Loop
description: A boom bap beat in C minor at 90 BPM, swing 0.2: a four-bar loop (Cm7, Fm7, Cm7, G7) with kick on 1, 6 and 10, snare on 2 and 4 slightly behind the grid, ghost snares, swung hats, a sub bass that follows the kick, dusty electric piano and a short pentatonic lead hook. Arranged as intro, verse, hook, verse B, hook and outro (40 bars, about 1 minute 47). Checked on paper and with measurements only; not listened to.
